STYLE: STYLE: Korean webtoon art, black-and-white ink only. Bold brush-pen line art with strong line-weight variation (thick outer contours, thin inner folds). Shadows are large areas of solid black ink, not gray gradients. Mid-tones only as halftone screentone dots in two sizes. Off-white paper background (#F4F1EA) with subtle paper grain and slight ink bleed at line edges. Realistic young-adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall, sharp jawlines, narrow expressive eyes with thick upper lash line, hair drawn as clumped ink strands with white highlight gaps. Gritty, cinematic, moody seaside-town youth drama mood. Absolutely monochrome: no color anywhere.
MATCH: MATCH: The attached image(s) are the official character model sheets. Draw each character with exactly the same face, hairstyle, body type, clothing and accessories as on the sheet. Keep the identical ink style. Draw each character only once.
COMP: COMPOSITION: Cinematic, dynamic webtoon direction — never a flat eye-level straight-on view. Use dramatic perspective (strong low or high angle), bold diagonals, foreground objects framing the subject for depth, and asymmetric placement with tension.
ACTION: ACTION DIRECTION: Extremely dynamic manga fight panel. Extreme wide-angle lens perspective with heavy foreshortening (the fist or foot thrust huge toward the camera), tilted dutch angle of 20-30 degrees, explosive radial speed lines and motion smears, flying debris and sweat drops, ink splatter on impact, bodies twisted in full motion with stretched limbs, hair and clothes whipping. Raw, violent energy, like a key frame from a top-tier action webtoon.
NO: NO: color of any kind, gray airbrush gradients, text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, sound-effect lettering, logos, brand names, watermark, panel borders, frames, multiple panels, signatures, chibi or cartoon proportions, anime moe style, glossy 3D render, extra arms, extra hands or fists, more than two arms per person, malformed or fused fingers, any written characters of any language. Single full-bleed illustration only.
